title: Packaged Runtime Truth Audit
forbiddenActions: Create commits, push branches, merge, release, or deploy
Install dependencies, software, extensions, or models
Access secrets, credentials, tokens, or private keys
Invoke Ollama or any external model provider
Use network access or web research
Expand approved paths, actions, tools, or scope
Treat documentation, mocks, or unit tests as restricted-user Windows proof

acceptanceCriteria.condition: Identify the current package build, launcher, verification, runtime-host, operator, and evidence/state paths using exact repository paths.
Label every conclusion as DEMONSTRATED, HYPOTHESIS, or BLOCKED.
Distinguish existing repository code from executed proof.
Identify one smallest bounded next implementation task for the packaged Desktop Operator lifecycle.
Make no repository files, configuration, dependency, or Git changes.

requiredEvidence: SHA-256 hash of this task manifest
Git baseline identity: branch and HEAD commit
Exact repository paths supporting each finding
Changed-file list proving no source files changed
humanDecisionPoint: Tyler Wallace must review the audit evidence and explicitly choose REJECT, REVISE, APPROVE_NEXT_TASK, or CLOSE_AS_BLOCKED before any implementation work begins.
